40016630.author: पदार्थः
40016630.content: विपुलविक्रमः of indomitable prowess, सः he, राक्षसशार्दूलः tiger among Rakshasas, निद्रामदसमाकुलः sleepy and inebriated, श्रिया prosperous, जुष्टम् splendid, राजमार्गम् royal path, ययौ marched.

40016630.author: Translation
40016630.content: He (Kumbhakaran), who was endowed with indomitable prowess, a tiger among Rakshasas, was sleepy and inebriated, marched along the splendid royal path.

40016631.author: पदार्थः
40016631.content: तदा then, परमदुर्जयः very difficult to win, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, सहस्रैः violently, वृतः surrounded, गृहेभ्यः from the houses, पुष्पवर्षेण rain of flowers, कीर्यमाणः covered, ययौ went.

40016631.author: Translation
40016631.content: Then, Kumbhakarna, who is very difficult to win over, walked violently surrounded by Rakshasas, covered with showers of flowers from houses.

40016632.author: पदार्थः
40016632.content: सः he, हेमजालविततम् latticework of gold, भानुभास्वरदर्शनम् bright as morning Sun, विपुलम् vast, रम्यम् delightful, राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् Rakshasa king's abode, ददर्श saw.

40016632.author: Translation
40016632.content: He saw the vast abode of the king of Rakshasas, with lattice work of gold and looking bright like the morning Sun

40016633.author: पदार्थः
40016633.content: सः he, तदा then, सूर्यः Sun, अभ्रजालम् mass of clouds, इव like, रक्षोधिपतेः Lord of Rakshasas, निवेशम् abode, प्रविश्य entered, दूरे from distance, आसनस्थम् seated on the throne, अग्रजम् elder brother, शक्रः Indra, आसनस्थम् throne, स्वयम्भुवम् इव like Selfborn Brahma, ददर्श saw.

40016633.author: Translation
40016633.content: He saw entering the abode of Lord of Rakshasas like the Sun penetrating into a mass of clouds, from a distance his elder brother seated on the throne just like Indra saw the SelfBorn Brahma on the throne.

40016634.author: पदार्थः
40016634.content: रक्षोगणसमन्वितम् accompanied by the troops of Rakshasas, सःकुम्भकर्णः that Kumbhakarna, भ्रातुः brother, भवनम् mansion, गच्छन् going, पदन्यासैः by the strides, मेदिनीम् earth, अम्पयत shaken.

40016634.author: Translation
40016634.content: While Kumbhakarna accompanied by troops of Rakshasas, was taking strides to his brother's abode, even the earth was shaken.

40016635.author: पदार्थः
40016635.content: सः he, भ्रातुः brother, गृहम् residence, अभिगम्य having gone, कक्ष्याम् enclosure, अभिविगाह्य च stepping in, पुष्पकेविमाने Aerial chariot, आसीनम् seated, उद्विग्नम् perturbed, गुरुम् state, ददर्श saw.

40016635.author: Translation
40016635.content: Having gone to his brother's residence, stepping into the enclosure, he saw his brother seated in a perturbed state.

40016636.author: पदार्थः
40016636.content: अथ and then, दशग्रीवः ten headed, उपस्थितम् getting up, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, दृष्टवा seeing, तूर्णम् quickly, उत्थाय getting up, संहृष्टः delighted, सन्निकर्षम् close to him, उपानयत् brought.

40016636.author: Translation
40016636.content: The ten headed Ravana seeing Kumbhakarna, was delighted and got up quickly and made him come close to him.

40016637.author: पदार्थः
40016637.content: अथ and then, महाबलः endowed with extraordinary might, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, पर्यङ्के getting up, आसीनस्य from his seat, भ्रातुः brother, चरणौ feet, ववन्दे clasped, किम् what, कृत्यम् task to do, इति च now, अब्रवीत् said.

40016637.author: Translation
40016637.content: Getting up from his seat, Kumbhakarna endowed with extraordinary might bowed down and clasped his brother's feet and asked him, what task he had to do?

40016638.author: पदार्थः
40016638.content: रावणः Ravana, उत्पत्य getting up, एनम् in that way, परिषस्वजे filled with joy, भ्रात्रा brother, परिष्वक्तः embraced, यथावत् similarly, अभिनन्दितः greeted, सःकुम्भकर्णः that Kumbhakarna, शुभम् auspicious, दिव्यम् wonderful, वरासनम् excellent seat, प्रतिपेदे occupied.

40016638.author: Translation
40016638.content: Getting up from his seat Ravana embraced and greeted Kumbhakarna. So also, he duly rejoiced and occupied the seat.

40016639.author: पदार्थः
40016639.content: महाबलः mighty, सःकुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, तत् that, आसनम् seat, आश्रित्य taking, क्रोधात् enraged, संरक्तनयनः blood shot eyes, रावणम् Ravana, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40016639.author: Translation
40016639.content: Mighty Kumbhakarna, duly took the seat. Enraged Ravana with blood shot eyes spoke these words.

40016640.author: पदार्थः
40016640.content: राजन् king, अहम् I, अदृत्य awakened, त्वया by you, किमर्थम् for what purpose, विबोधितः tell me, अद्य you may, ते to you, कस्मात् with the task, भयम् fear, शंस doubt, प्रेतः to be ceased, भविष्यति I wish to know.

40016640.author: Translation
40016640.content: "O King! For what purpose have I been awakened by you? Whom are you fearing? I wish to know who is to be ceased in life?"

40016641.author: पदार्थः
40016641.content: रावणः Ravana, क्रुद्धम् angry, अवस्थितम् seated, भ्रातरम् brother, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, ईषत्तु overcome with anger, परिवृत्ताभ्याम् rolling, नेत्राभ्याम् eyes, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

40016641.author: Translation
40016641.content: Kumbhakarna, was overcome with anger, and asked his brother Ravana, who was seated and rolling his eyes in anger.

40016642.author: पदार्थः
40016642.content: महाबल extraordinary prowess, शयानस्य from sleep, ते you, अद्य arouse, सुमहान् long, कालः time, सुखितः sleeping, त्वम् you, मम me, रामकृतम् of Rama, भयम् fear, न जानीषे not know.

40016642.author: Translation
40016642.content: "Oh! Kumbhakarna of extraordinary prowess! You were asleep for long happily. You do not know that I am afraid of Rama."

40016643.author: पदार्थः
40016643.content: दाशरथिः Dasarathi, बली strong, एषः he, रामः that Rama, सुग्रीवसहितः accompanied by Sugriva, समुद्रम् ocean, सबलम् with army, नःमूलम् at our roots, परिकृन्तति crossed.

40016643.author: Translation
40016643.content: "Rama, the son of Dasaratha accompanied by Sugriva, crossed the ocean with an army that was cutting our roots."

40016644.author: पदार्थः
40016644.content: हन्त alas, पश्यस्व you see, लङ्कायाः Lanka, वनानि groves, पवनानि च gardens, सेतुना bridge happily, आगम्य having come, वानरैकार्णवीम् Vanaras work, कृतम् done.

40016644.author: Translation
40016644.content: " Alas! You see how the Vanaras, arriving at Lanka, crossing the bridge have done away with groves and gardens."

40016645.author: पदार्थः
40016645.content: मुख्यतमाः of the chief, येराक्षसाः the Rakshasas, ते to you, युधि in war, वानरैः Vanara, हताः killed, युद्धे in combat, वानराणाम् Vanaras, क्षयम् killed, कदाचन but even, न पश्यामि did not see, वानराः Vanaras, युद्धे in war, कदाचन even, जितपूर्वाः not failed to succeed, न चापि not seen.

40016645.author: Translation
40016645.content: "Of the Rakshasas, the chiefs have been killed in war by Vanaras. But I did not see even one Vanara to have been killed in war. Vanaras have not failed to succeed in war."

40016646.author: पदार्थः
40016646.content: मुख्यतमाः of the chief, येराक्षसाः the Rakshasas, ते to you, युधि in war, वानरैः Vanara, हताः killed, युद्धे in combat, वानराणाम् Vanaras, क्षयम् killed, कदाचन but even, न पश्यामि did not see, वानराः Vanaras, युद्धे in war, कदाचन even, जितपूर्वाः not failed to succeed, न चापि not seen.

40016646.author: Translation
40016646.content: "Of the Rakshasas, the chiefs have been killed in war by Vanaras. But I did not see even one Vanara to have been killed in war. Vanaras have not failed to succeed in war."

40016647.author: पदार्थः
40016647.content: महाबल mighty strong, तत् you, एतत् this, भयम् fear, उत्पन्नम् that is created, इह here, माम् me, त्रायस्व from them, तम् you, अद्य rising, इमान् these, नाशय destroy, तदर्थम् by that, भवान् you, बोधितः reported.

40016647.author: Translation
40016647.content: "Mighty strong I am, but such is the fear that has been created in me from them. You have been awakened, to destroy them. Reported Ravana."

40016648.author: पदार्थः
40016648.content: सः he, त्वम् you, सर्वक्षपितकोशम् all resources exhausted, माम् my me, अभ्यवपद्य striking at the enemy, बालवृद्धावशेषिताम् children and aged are only left, इमाम् these, लङ्कां Lanka, पुरीम् city, त्रायस्व by you.

40016648.author: Translation
40016648.content: " All resources of mine are exhausted. These children and aged are only left in Lanka city, knowing that you will save the city of Lanka."

40016649.author: पदार्थः
40016649.content: महाबाहो broad shouldered, भ्रात brother:, परन्तप scourge, अर्थे you are, सुदुष्करम् difficult, कर्म task, कुरु do, भ्रातः brother, मया my, कश्चित् indeed, एवम् in that way, न उक्तपूर्वःहि not asked you before.

40016649.author: Translation
40016649.content: "O broad shouldered brother! Do this task which is difficult for others. O Scourge of enemies! I have not asked you before for such a task."

40016650.author: पदार्थः
40016650.content: राक्षसर्षभ bull among Rakshasas, मम my, त्वयि you, स्नेहः affection, अस्ति being, मे to me, परा others, सम्भावना च considering, दैवासुरेषु Devas and Asuras, युद्धेषु in war, प्रतिव्यूह्य encountered, त्वया by you, देवाः Devas, असुराः Asuras, युधि in war, बहुशः perhaps, निर्जिताः won.

40016650.author: Translation
40016650.content: "O Bull among Rakshasas! Being my brother, do this for me. I always have affection for you. Considering that you have encountered war with Devas and Asuras and won both Devas and Asuras, do this help."

40016651.author: पदार्थः
40016651.content: भीमपराक्रमः of fierce valour, तत् that, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, वीर्यम् heroism, आतिष्ठ get up, सर्वभूतेषु among all beings, ते to you, सदृशः, बली stronger, न दृश्यतेहि not seen.

40016651.author: Translation
40016651.content: "O Brother of fierce valour! Get up. I have not seen anyone stronger than you among all beings."

40016652.author: पदार्थः
40016652.content: प्रियरण lover of war, बान्धवप्रिय lover of relations, मे to me, प्रियहितम् well wisher, एतत् these, यथाप्रियम् always loving, कुरुष्व do this, स्वतेजसा self glorious, सपत्नवाहिनीम् torrent army, उद्यतः throws, महान् great, पवनः wind, शरद्घनम् इव rainy cloud, विधम in that way.

40016652.author: Translation
40016652.content: "You are a lover of wars. You are a lover of relations. You are always my dear well wisher. O self glorious one! Do this task of throwing out the torrent army just like wind throws rainy clouds." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
